title: buceras catappa
intro: Buceras catappa, commonly known as Catappa or Indian almond leaves, is a tropical tree native to South and Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Catappa leaves include reducing stress and inflammation, promoting a healthy gut, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Catappa are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Catappa leaves include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
